# Packages

```         
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)
```

# User Inputs

## File Path

```{r}
data <- read.csv("Plates/Nitrite/06192026_nitrite_1.csv")
```

## Standard Curve

Depending on the standard used, the curve will different x-axis values to match the different standards.

```{r}
USE_HIGH_RANGE <- FALSE
```

## Bad Standards

After assessing the standard curve with all standards, it may be necessary to remove standards to get a better r\^2 value.

```{r}
ROWS_TO_DROP <- c()
```

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
